parties: Navigant Corporate Advisors Ltd (acquirer) | Niraj Cement Structurals Limited (target)
headline: Niraj Cement Structurals Limited: Public Announcement-Open Offer
sum: Navigant Corporate Advisors has filed a SEBI Regulation 3(1) public announcement for a mandatory open offer on Niraj Cement Structurals Limited, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares triggering takeover disclosure requirements under SEBI SAST Regulations 2011.
implication: The triggering of Regulation 3(1) SAST norms indicates Navigant has crossed or is announcing a threshold acquisition; counsel must verify whether the 25% / 51% / control threshold has been met and ensure all Regulation 13–15 conditions precedent (disclosure, timing, pricing formula) are satisfied before the open offer window closes.
detail: Navigant Corporate Advisors Ltd has submitted to NSE a public announcement under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Regulation 3(1) read with Regulations 13, 14 and 15(1). This filing is the mandatory disclosure step when a party acquires 25% or more shares (or control) of a listed company, triggering the open offer obligation. The announcement was filed with the exchange on 16 June 2026. The exact consideration, acquirer intent, and target valuation are not disclosed in the public announcement excerpt; full details are expected in the formal offer document and scheme circular.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Reg. 3(1)
framework.note: Triggers mandatory disclosure when a person acquires 25% or more shares or voting rights, or control, in a listed company.
Public announcement requirements: timing, content, disclosure to stock exchange and company before public disclosure.
Open offer mechanics: timing (within 4 days of public announcement), price (calculated per formula), acceptance period (min. 21 days).
Conditions precedent and exemptions: board approval, funding, conditions precedent due diligence, regulatory approvals if applicable.
If the takeover involves a scheme of arrangement, the Regulation 233 NCLT approval process must be followed.
If acquirer intends full delisting post-open offer, the acquirer must comply with delisting squeeze-out and reversal provisions.

framework.ref: Stock Exchange Listing Agreement / SEBI Listing Regulations 2015, Chapter V
framework.note: Continuous disclosure obligations, corporate governance norms post-acquisition.

framework.ref: Foreign Exchange Management Act 1999 / FDI Policy
framework.note: If Navigant is a foreign acquirer or has foreign backing, FDI sectoral caps and FIPB approval may apply.

conditions: Public announcement under Reg. 3(1) SAST filed with NSE
Open offer document to be filed within 4 days of public announcement (per Reg. 14)
Offer price to be determined per SEBI price formula (usually based on 6-month/2-year VWAP or independent valuer assessment)
Acceptance period minimum 21 days from offer document filing
Funding confirmation / board approval (Reg. 15 conditions precedent)
approvals: Stock Exchange approval (formal open offer filing)
NCLT approval if scheme of arrangement is contemplated
structure.novel: Navigant Corporate Advisors filing on behalf of the acquirer is standard SAST procedure; no unusual structure apparent from the announcement excerpt.
